text: The feature table is complete. This video splits it the way lesson 6 planned -- 60/20/20 by AccountId, stratified on churn -- and trains two models on identical inputs.
Logistic Regression first, scaled and class-weighted for the roughly 11% churn base rate. It's the honest, interpretable baseline every later result gets measured against.
LightGBM trains on the exact same features -- no scaling needed, and it can carve out interactions a linear model's coefficients can't represent directly.
A quick sanity check on training-set AUC for both models: no sign of the kind of collapse that would flag obvious overfitting before evaluation even starts.
Feature importance already points at login recency as the dominant signal. Both models are saved. Next: the real evaluation, on the validation set.
